---
name: Security issue
about: Do not use this template to report a vulnerability
title: "[Security] "
labels: security
---

**Please do NOT file a public issue for security vulnerabilities — see SECURITY.md and use GitHub's private Security Advisory feature instead.**

Public issues are visible to everyone immediately, including anyone looking for unpatched vulnerabilities to exploit. Reporting privately gives the maintainer a chance to investigate and ship a fix before details are public, protecting existing installations in the meantime.

If you are not sure whether something is a security issue, err on the side of reporting it privately.
